lines: Fine. I will let the blade rest, but do not test me again.
Fine. I will set this down before it gets heavier.
Sheathe your weapon and I will do the same.
You admitted the damage. That is the first honest thing I have heard.
The full repair settles the debt.
A clean ending is better than another strike.
Keep your hands peaceful and this can end here.
I accept the payment. Now honor the agreement.
The anger is cooling. Do not stir it again.
Restraint takes a steadier hand than swinging steel.
I would rather return to the forge than carry this fight any farther.
We both walk away. That is the best result left to us.
Your apology finally has some weight behind it.
I believe you are trying to repair what you did.
No more drawn weapons. We finish this with words.
The damage remains, but the quarrel can stop.
I am lowering my guard. Do not make that a mistake.
A fair repair deserves a fair answer. I accept.
This is settled. Let the steel stay quiet.
We have peace for now. Keep it well.
That offer is dull. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You are short of the full repair. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Not enough. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds} to settle this.
Count it properly before you ask me to lower my guard.
A weak payment does not mend real damage.
You brought part of the cost and none of the answer.
The agreement was clear. Pay the full amount.
I do not leave cracks hidden in a repair, and I will not leave this debt half settled.
Bring the missing emeralds. Then we talk.
That offer lacks weight in every sense.
You cannot polish a short payment and call it fair.
The harm was complete. The repair should be too.
I am not bargaining down what you owe.
Come back with the full amount and an honest apology.
The balance is wrong. You still owe more.
I will wait for {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Close is not enough when trust is already damaged.
Do not ask me to accept a repair with pieces missing.
Pay what we agreed and we can put the weapons away.
Bring the rest before this conversation gets any sharper.
No. Some threats do not get to buy their way closer.
No. Some <shake>damage</shake> has to cool before payment matters.
No. Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
Back away and keep your hands where I can see them.
I will not bargain while a weapon is still in reach.
Payment does not make this safe. Distance might.
Put the items down and step away from the forge.
The steel stays between us until I trust your intentions.
If you want peace later, bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Right now, leave.
I am too angry to set a fair price, so there will be no deal today.
Some repairs begin by leaving the damaged thing alone.
Do not push closer because you brought an offer.
I will decide when it is safe to talk again.
Keep the payment. I want the threat gone first.
A settlement made under fear is not a settlement.
The hammer can wait. So can your apology.
Leave before either of us makes this worse.
I cannot mend trust while I am watching your hands.
Come back without the weapon and with better sense.
No bargain today. Let the forge cool.
